title: HtmlFigcaption
responsibility: Renders the native figcaption element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlFigcaption.attributes
inputs.description: Native figcaption attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlFigcaption.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native figcaption element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlFigcaption
outputs.description: The actual native figcaption element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
